variants.text: face shape: oval; eyebrows: moderately thick, soft-arched, lateral peak, moderate brow-to-eye vertical distance; eyes: almond, slight upward canthal tilt, average palpebral fissure length, moderate upper-lid double crease, average intercanthal distance; nose: straight nasal dorsum, average root width, rounded tip, moderate projection, narrow alar base; mouth: medium-width, even upper-to-lower fullness ratio, defined cupid's bow, level lip corners; skin surface: smooth, no persistent marks

Almond eyes with a slight upward canthal tilt, moderate upper-lid double crease, and average intercanthal distance accompany moderately thick, soft-arched eyebrows featuring a lateral peak and moderate brow-to-eye vertical distance. The oval face displays a straight nasal dorsum with a rounded tip, moderate projection, and a narrow alar base, alongside a medium-width mouth characterized by a defined cupid's bow, even fullness ratio, and level lip corners. The skin surface is smooth with no persistent marks visible.
